title: Fixed intrinsic realization and normalized exceptional chart comparison objects
statement: Retain the constructed comparison family from det-sp-reduction-exceptional: reductionSite is ordinary-etale comparison inverse image followed by the fixed intrinsic derived equivalence; reductionSiteScalarIso is its section-normalized scalar mate; reductionSiteCompactSupportIso is the proper-counit/open compact-support comparison. ReductionExceptionalRealization consists of an ordinary-etale origin functor with bounded constructible finite-Tor values and an origin isomorphism, an ordinary right adjoint of the identical fixed compactification, its bounded-below output property, and an output isomorphism whose actual counit is reductionRealizationCounitEquation. The chart right isomorphism is counit-preserving right-adjoint uniqueness for sum/evaluation followed by ordered affine integration. ReductionExceptionalChartEquation asserts existence of the uniquely site-normalized input scalar comparison, and identifies every open restriction of the intrinsic coefficient transpose with the ordered Tate scalar reassociation, followed by that input comparison. These are existing constructions, relocated verbatim; no datum is supplied by an unproved mere-existence theorem.
